Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Geometry and admission/issue desktop views exist, and the column mapping host is embedded in StudioWindow. The ticket requires a stronger composition: selected-revision wizard Geometry and Data issues pages must be sibling panes sharing one view model and one ReviseDataset commit, with tab order and Data-board parity re-derived. Existing independent views do not prove that integration. Finish the pane wiring and add a navigation/commit test that traverses wizard and sibling panes without duplicate revision commands.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/geometry/GeometryPaneHost.scala:37
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/admission/AdmissionLedgerView.scala:28
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/StudioWindow.scala:427

Remaining / next action: Host both wizard pages as coordinated Data siblings and test selection, tab order, and one-command commit.

Disposition: Keep open.
